expected_claims.name: Open Legal Compliance MCP
expected_claims.tagline: Community MCP for searching public legal and regulatory sources.
expected_claims.description: The TCoder920x repository documents searches across public legal and regulatory sources, including GovInfo, CourtListener, Congress.gov, the Federal Register and selected international sources. GovInfo credentials are required to start the server; other capabilities require their own optional keys or scraping access. This is a community research connector, not a determination that a client or activity complies with law. Verify retrieved material against its original source. Documentation reviewed on October 27, 2026; customer-account access and deployed operation have not been tested.
expected_claims.pricing_details: MIT-licensed server code; API registrations, hosting and connected-service terms or costs are separate. A GovInfo API key is required.

expected_claims.name: CourtListener MCP (Free Law Project)
expected_claims.tagline: Official CourtListener access for case law, dockets, judges, citations and alerts.
expected_claims.description: Free Law Project hosts the official CourtListener MCP server. Its documentation describes searching U.S. case law, dockets, judges and oral arguments, citation tools and alert management. Interactive clients use a CourtListener account with OAuth; the maintainer also documents API-token authentication for other clients. Some tools can change account state or request documents, so inspect permissions and possible charges. Documentation reviewed; an account connection was not tested.
expected_claims.pricing_details: The maintainer documents free individual accounts. Usage limits, memberships, document purchases and other charges depend on the service and account; confirm current terms.
